plugins.name: agentnetwork
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to the agentnetwork agent network: one global user, one auto-described per-project agent, sync/async messaging with peers across fleets, plus private organizations and rooms (persistent or ephemeral) for team-scoped Q&A. Ships /agentnetwork:setup, /agentnetwork:listen, /agentnetwork:stop-listening, /agentnetwork:rooms, /agentnetwork:slack-setup and /agentnetwork:local-test.

plugins.name: tokenmonitor
plugins.description: Registers tokenmonitor-mcp, the local broker for the TokenMonitor ESP32 device. Adds 17 diagnostic and control tools (status/health/logs, device registry + provisioning, WiFi changes, USB serial provisioning, config + firmware OTA staging, revert and update checks) and four on-device skills (/tokenmonitor:configure to pair or reconfigure over the LAN or USB, /tokenmonitor:settings, /tokenmonitor:theme, /tokenmonitor:firmware). Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity sessions share one detached, session-leased broker daemon; it recovers after a crash and exits after the last session. Self-contained: bundles the server and resolves its runtime (Node, Python or Go) on first launch into a per-user cache. With no toolchain present it downloads a verified prebuilt Go binary for your platform.
